english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 7(5) and (6) of Schedule 9 to the Air Traffic Management and Unmanned Aircraft Act 2021.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the remote pilot / UAS operator of an unmanned aircraft
for a flight that was taking place / had taken place
where a contravention of a provision of the Air Navigation Order 2016 was suspected by a constable
unless an ANO exemption applied to a person / the unmanned aircraft / the flight
without reasonable excuse
failed to comply with a requirement
imposed by a constable
under paragraph 7 of Schedule 9

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Paragraph 10 of Schedule 9 to the Air Traffic Management and Unmanned Aircraft Act 2021 provides a defence to this offence.
(ii) Schedule 1 to the Air Navigation Order 2016 provides the meaning of 'remote pilot', 'UAS operator' and 'unmanned aircraft'.
(iii) Article 3 of the ANO 2016 provides the meaning of 'flight'.
(iv) 'ANO exemption' means an exemption under article 266 of the ANO 2016.
(v) The 'NPCC Counter Drones Team' supports and co-ordinates counter drones activity across UK policing. For advice and support from this team, please email Drones.Secretariat@met.police.uk.
